methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing for AI image-generation tools (Midjourney, OpenAI/ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly, Leonardo.ai, Ideogram, Recraft, Krea) was collected from each vendor's public pricing page on the accessedAt date and normalized to USD; where a vendor's live pricing page blocked automated fetching, the published figures were taken from independent pricing references and cross-checked, with a corroborating source attached. monthlyUsd records the month-to-month list price for flat tiers and the per-seat/per-user list price for per_seat tiers (noted in plan notes), with annualDiscountPct capturing the published annual saving. These are not telephony products, so minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin and overagePerCall are null on every plan, HIPAA/BAA/bilingual are null, and quote-only / contact-sales tiers carry a null price rather than an estimate.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $30/mo month-to-month; $24/mo equivalent at annual billing (20% off). ~15 fast GPU hours per month plus unlimited Relax mode generation, commercial usage rights (companies under $1M annual revenue).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $60/mo month-to-month; $48/mo equivalent at annual billing (20% off). ~30 fast GPU hours per month, unlimited Relax mode, Stealth Mode (private generation), full commercial rights, 12 concurrent fast jobs.

plans.name: Mega
plans.notes: $120/mo month-to-month; $96/mo equivalent at annual billing (20% off). ~60 fast GPU hours per month, unlimited Relax mode, Stealth Mode, full commercial rights.
